answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the river check immediately, the saffron audit keeps the resolved set and the basalt replay reveals exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 204 aliases as a result pays the reading cost 204 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
